# defectdojo_product (List Resource)

Lists the DefectDojo products the provider user may see, ordered by name. The generated configuration sets `authorized_users`, `regulation_ids`, `tags` and `sla_configuration_id`.

Requires Terraform 1.14 or later. Terraform returns at most 100 results unless the `list` block sets `limit`. `terraform query -generate-config-out` writes every attribute that has a value, including those the provider otherwise leaves to others when they are not configured (such as `authorized_users` and `tags`): remove the ones another system manages before applying the generated configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Find the products, and generate import blocks and configuration with:
#   terraform query -generate-config-out=generated.tf
# Terraform returns at most 100 results unless limit is set. The generated
# configuration sets authorized_users, regulation_ids, tags and
# sla_configuration_id: remove those another system manages.
list "defectdojo_product" "all" {
  provider = defectdojo
  limit    = 1000
}

# Only the products of one product type whose name contains "shop", ignoring case
list "defectdojo_product" "shop" {
  provider = defectdojo

  config {
    product_type_id = 1
    name_contains   = "shop"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_contains` (String) Only list the products whose name contains this text, ignoring case.
- `product_type_id` (Number) Only list the products of the product type with this ID. A product type that doesn't exist lists nothing.
